Guided inspection mode

Seven steps, top to bottom. Progress is stored in this browser only.

Park level, transmission in Park, parking brake set, wheels chocked, engine and exhaust cool. Anything requiring you to get under the truck requires rated jack stands — never a jack alone.

Fluid reference center

Capacities below are from the Ford Owner’s Manual capacities page for the 5.0L. Where two Ford-linked sources disagree on grade, both are shown — confirm against the oil filler cap and your Owner’s Manual.

Capacities — 5.0L Ti-VCT V8

SystemCapacitySource
Never mix fluid types. Coolant, brake fluid, transfer case fluid and axle lubricant are all specification-critical on this truck. Substituting a “universal” product is the fastest route to an expensive repair.
